data.title: About Nilesh
bio: Dr.  Nilesh Shah was born and raised in Mumbai, India.  Nilesh has lived in NJ since 1985.  Nilesh is married to Kajal Shah, who is also his real estate team partner in TheTeamShah, and they have 3 children Naman (31), Navan (25) and Giya (16).  Nilesh is working as a real estate professional since 2021.

Nilesh brings over 3 decades’ experience as an IT Director and as a college dean, assisting, mentoring and supervising students and professionals.  Nilesh is an educator.  Nilesh is client-centric, engaging and result-oriented.  Delivering extraordinary customer service has always been Nilesh’s motto.  Nilesh has a knack for taking care of people’s needs and making sure they achieve the best outcome.

Nilesh is also a licensed mortgage professional.  When it comes to your real estate needs, Nilesh is there!  Nelish enjoys traveling, singing, drawing, collecting artwork, decorating, watching movies, and TV shows, in his free time.  He is fluent in English, Hindi, and Gujarati.
